$schema.description: Path to the JSON Schema, for editor autocompletion.

name.description: Display name of the site. The file name must be the slug of this name.

url.description: URL of a profile page. "{}" is replaced by the username. Shown to the user.

urlProbe.description: URL actually requested, when it differs from `url` (an API endpoint for example).

anyOf.description: How a missing account is detected: `message` (an error text is in the page), `status_code` (the HTTP status is not 2xx or is in `errorCode`) or `response_url` (the site redirects instead of answering 2xx).

items.description: How a missing account is detected: `message` (an error text is in the page), `status_code` (the HTTP status is not 2xx or is in `errorCode`) or `response_url` (the site redirects instead of answering 2xx).

errorType.description: Detection strategy, or several strategies applied in order.

errorMsg.description: Text(s) present in the page when the account does NOT exist. Required by `message`.

errorCode.description: HTTP status code(s) meaning the account does NOT exist, even if 2xx.

regexCheck.description: Usernames that do not match this regex are not supported by the site (no request).

username_claimed.description: A username known to exist on the site. Used by the automated checks.

isNSFW.description: Adult content. Excluded from searches by default.

headers.description: Extra HTTP headers sent with the request.

request_method.description: HTTP method. Defaults to HEAD for `status_code` only, GET otherwise.

request_payload.description: JSON body sent with the request. "{}" is replaced by the username, recursively.
